name: NYLON
summary: For a classical guitar: stick it on the top and lifting the neck is the pedal. A looper under ten effects: clouds, a bloom that holds your note, tape echo, wah, shimmer, octaves, golpe drums, a voice.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Stuck on the guitar's top, screen out. A footswitch wired in parallel with REC (GPIO 3 to ground) frees your hands. BLOOM ON WOOD wants the speaker amp's output on the top: the small speaker pressed against it, or a stick-on exciter.
status_note: Played on a guitar on 2026-10-24 (0.1.0, then 0.1.1 notes). 0.1.2 (the freeze on the stick, SLAP SETUP, no button click in the loop, bars and a count-in) passes the simulator.
